LOOK: Protesters gather in Iloilo City on Tuesday, March 17, as diesel prices breach ₱100 per liter amid the war in the Middle East.

To ease the impact, the group is calling on the government to pressure oil companies to roll back prices to ₱55 per liter for old supply and remove the VAT and excise tax on oil products.

PISTON and allied groups are also set to join the transport strike on Thursday, March 19.

📷 Tara Yap | MB
